tei:div.tei:p: (da)༄༅// sgrub pa'i thabs kun las btus pa dngos grub rin po che'i 'dod 'jo'i dkar chag gi yi ge bkra shis grub pa'i chu gter zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ kun gsal ngos su dbang po'i gzhu ris bzhin// spros bral dbyings las ye shes sgyu ma'i sku// rnam kun mchog ldan 'gyur med bde ba che// zung 'jug srid zhi'i khyab bdag chen por 'dud// spangs rtogs ngo bor rgyal kun dbyer med kyang*// snyigs 'gror skyobs pa'i thugs bskyed phrin las la// phyogs bcu'i 'dren pas bsngags pa'i me tog char// lhan cig 'thor ba shākya'i dbang pos skyongs// grub pa'i bdud rtsis snying la sim gyur pas// lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung zab gsang lam// mos dang skal ba ji bzhin gsal mdzad pa// 'phags bod thub pa'i bstan skyong che rnams bsngags// 'jam̐m dbyangam̐s ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i zol bstan kyang*// mkhyeṃn brtseṃ ye shes rgyal dang dbyer med pa// gangs ljongs mkhas dang grub pa'i dbangaṃ poṃ'i zhabs// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos spyi bor mchod// thugs bskyed smon lam dus su sad pa las// bka' bab bdun gyi phrin las zla med pas// ris med bstan pa'i srog rtsa bzung ba yi// rnam thar dper 'os thub dbang nyid las med// ngo mtshar mdzad pa nam mkha'i mu khyud las// gdul bya'i blor 'tshams shas tsam snang byed pa'i// sgrub thabs kun las btus pa'i chos sde 'dir// bzhugs tshul dkar chag mthong gsal dgod par bya// lhag pa'i lha rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs kun las btus pa'i chos skor bdud rtsi'i chu gter dngos grub rba rlabs chil chil g.yo ba'i bzhugs tshogs dkar chag mdor bsdus bkod pa la/ 'phags yul gyi paṇa chen smra ba'i seng ge rnams kyis bka' thams cad phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang*/ bstan bcos thams cad rtsis 'go lngas 'chad pa'i rjes su 'brang ste cung zad smos na/

ji skad du/ 'di yi mdzad pa po ni su// phyogs ni gar gtogs lung gar btus// gzhung gi tshad ni ji tsam yod// 'di yi dgos pa'ang ci zhig yin// zhes 'byung ba ltar na/ dang po mdzad pa po ni gangs ri'i rwa bas yongs su bskor ba'i ljongs na 'gran zla gnyis pa ma mchis pa mkhas shing grub pa yongs kyi khyu mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes snyan par grags pa lha'i rnga sgras 'khor yug dang bcas pa'i ri bo'i gtos kun tu khyab pa de nyid de/ de ni gangs can ljongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'i chos brgyad dang ldan pa ste/ thog mar bslu med rdo rje'i lung gis zin pa'i khyad par ni/ gter ston kun gyi rgyal po mnga' bdag nyang rin po che'i gter lung las/ rtse sgang zhes pa'i ri bo'i mdun// pha waṃ klu dbang 'khyil pa'i steng*// mnga' bdag 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes 'byung*// bcu gsum zab mo'i gter la spyod// ces mnga' bdag tshangs pa lha'i me tog gi ye shes sgyu ma'i rang gzugs su gsal bar lung bstan pas mtshon/ rin chen gling pa/ rdo rje gling pa/ mnga' ri'i paṇa chen/ bdud 'dul nus ldan rdo rje sogs gter rnying rnams dang*/ phyis su o rgyan mchog gyur gling pa'i lung byang rnams las kyang rnam thar mdzad phrin sku che ba'i yon tan sogs shin tu gsal ba rgyas par 'byung bas/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa gu ru rin po che'i rdo rje'i lung gis zin pa ni ches dkon cing 'khrul med kyi lung gis zin pa des ni bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che mdzad pa chos nyid do// gnyis pa sku bltams pa dang gzhon nu rol rtsed skabs gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'i tshul ni/ rgyal bas chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen dkar phyogs kyi tshes bzang por sku bltams rgyu'i sngar nub tho rangs tsam du nam mkha' nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'i 'od chen po byung nas khyim de yun ring du khyab pa dang*/

nang mor chu blangs nas yar khyim du sleb skabs 'o mar 'gyur ba sogs gzhan la 'byung mi srid pa'i dge mtshan bkra shis rtags kyi ri mo sna tshogs su shar bar 'dug cing*/ de nyin nyin phyed rta'i dus tsam la ma bsgrigs lhun grub kyi lung nas bstan pa'i gnas ri bo khyung chen lding ba'i nye zhol du ras dkar gyi lding gur yangs pa'i nang du skyed byed la zug rngu'i tshor ba ci yang med pas bde bar sku bltams pa'i skabs dbu skra lcang lo nag si le bas sku stod yan khebs pa dang*/ phru ma chos gos kyi tshul du dkris pa'i steng dag byed bkra shis kyi rtswa mchog ku shas bsdams pa sogs 'byung bar dkon pa'i ltas bzang phun sum tshogs pa byung bar snang*/ rim par sku nar son pa'i skabs g.yon phyogs brag dkar ngos su o rgyan rin po che'i sku shin tu gsal ba dus rgyun tu gzigs pa dang*/ brag ri sogs snang ba thams cad lha skur 'char zhing chu rlabs rnams kyang 'ja' 'od dang yig 'bru'i rnam pa yang nas yang du gsal ba dang*/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po dang*/ dpal ldan sngags kyi srung mas zhabs 'degs bsgrub pa rgyun tu gzigs pa dang*/ rgyal dbang pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ rgyal yum ye shes mtsho rgyal/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po rnams kyis zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs pas/ dgongs pa'i gter kha du ma thugs las brdol zhing sa gter 'ga' zhig kyang phyag tu son par snang yang byis pa'i dus nas thugs shin tu sgam par bzhugs pas ches gsang ba'i rgyas btab ste sus kyang mngon par ma gyur/ gzhan yang rtsa gsum lhag pa'i lha du mas zhal gzigs pa dang sngon gyi skyes pa'i rabs mang po gsal bar dran pas de dag gi rnam thar shugs 'byung du skyong ba dang*/ khyad par du rgyal sras lha rje'i bag chags shin tu gsal bas bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor dang gtor mchod sogs yin zhes shog bu kha dog sna tshogs dang 'jim pa la bcos pa rnams bkod nas 'don tshig cho ga du mar 'dzad med du gsungs pa dang*/

dbang bskur chos 'chad kyis mtshon rnam 'dren mchog gi mdzad pa'i zlos gar gzhan gyis 'gran zla dang bral ba cir yang bsgyur bar mdzad pas mchog dman thams cad nas rtsod pa dang bral ba'i sprul pa'i sku'i snyan grags dbyar rnga'i sgra dbyangs phyogs thams cad du grags par snang ngo*// gsum pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen phyogs med du bsten pas khyad par 'phags pa ni/ spyir 'phags pa'i yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'bras bu dus lnga brgya pa phrag bcu'i skabs rim bzhin dgra bcom pa dang*/ phyir mi 'ong ba dang*/ lan gcig phyir 'ong dang*/ rgyun tu zhugs pa kho nar byon pas bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs tshad 'phags pa'i sa ma thob pa gcig kyang med/ 'bras dus yol nas sgrub dus su slebs pa na khyad par du 'phags pa'i dge 'dun btsun pa'i sde 'bum phrag du mar bzhugs kyang 'phags sa thob pa gcig kyang med/ 'phags pa rnams ni gzungs thob pa kho na yin pas gsung rab mtha' dag thugs la bzhugs pas glegs bam gcig kyang ma dgos/ so skye rnams ni gzungs ma thob pas 'di skabs nas theg dman gyi mdo 'dul rnams glegs bam rgya cher 'bri ba'i srol byung*/ 'bras dus yol la nye ba'i skabs tsam nas btsun pa a bi tarka sogs sems tsam grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i slob dpon lnga brgyar grags pa rnams rim gyis byon/ de rnams 'jam dbyangs dang sgrib pa rnam sel sogs nye ba'i sras chen po brgyad dang mjal zhing byin gyis brlabs/ theg chen gyi mdo sde rnams kyi bka' lung stsal/ lha klu gnod sbyin dri za sogs yul tha dad pa rnams nas theg pa chen po'i mdo sde du ma spyan drangs/ glegs bam du bkod pa rnams rdo rje gdan gyi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs su gsol/ btsun pa chen po phal cher yang de la dad nas theg chen par grags pa la nyan thos pa rnams kyis theg chen gyi mdo sde rnams rgyal ba'i bka' ma yin pa'i gtan tshigs mang du bkod/

sangs rgyas 'das nas lo bzhi brgya tsam na slob dpon klu sgrub byon/ dgung lo drug brgya tsam mi yul du bzhugs/ sku tshe'i stod la gtam tshogs/ bar du rig tshogs dang bstod tshogs mdzad/ theg pa chen po bka' ru bsgrub cing sems tsam gyi grub mtha' bkag nas dbu ma'i gzhung lugs thog mar btsugs/ sku tshe'i smad la gsang ba 'dus pa sogs sngags skor rnams gsal bar spel/ sku tshe'i rked pa tsam la chos nyid kyi bden pa gzigs te 'phags pa'i sa brnyes/ klu'i rgyal pos spyan drangs te klu yul du byon nas sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa spyan drangs pa nas theg chen gyi mdo sde byon pa'i rjes ma yin/ de rjes mi lo bzhi brgya tsam na thogs med sku mched byon/ thogs med kyis byams pa lo bcu gnyis su bsgrubs pas dga' ldan tu byon te byams chos sde lnga gsan/ sa gsum pa brnyes pa'i 'phags par gyur te slar mi yul du phebs/ sa sde lnga sogs bstan bcos rgya cher mdzad/ byams chos thun mong pa bzhi po khyab brdal du spel/ 'khor lo tha ma'i dgongs 'grel rgyud bla ma gzhan gyi blor mi shong bar dgongs nas gter du sbas pa phyis mnga' bdag mai tri pa la lung bstan ltar phyungs te slob ma mchog rnams la spel ba las nges don dbu ma chen po'i grub mtha' byung*/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa mthar thug pa yin pas lta ba'i gnad ji bzhin pa 'phags pa'i sa brnyes pa ma gtogs so skye'i blos brtag par mi bzod pas 'phags bod kyi rtog ge pa rnams kyis mu stegs rtag lta dang mtshungs pa'i grub mtha' tha chad du 'dzin pa ni rang nyid ches skal ba dman pa'i skyon tu ma zad sems can dmyal ba pa'i 'og gzhi mthar thug par yun ring du bzhugs par spro ba'i sta gon la bzhugs par snang ngo*// rdo rje gdan gyi gtsug lag la phyi rol gyi dgra lan gsum byung ba dang lhag par mu stegs nyi ma'i dngos grub kyis nyi ma lo bcu gnyis su bsgrubs nas gtsug lag khang la bltas pas phyin nang thams cad bsregs/

theg pa chen po'i mdo sde'i glegs bam rnams kyang thal ba'i khrod nas phran bu tsam las rnyed rgyu ma byung bas theg pa chen po'i chos sde sum cha gnyis tsam nub/ sum cha gcig tsam lus/ khyad par sde snod gsum las mngon pa'i sde snod rtsa ba nas nub/ dper na 'bum chen sde lnga las dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i le'u 'bum bzhugs pa las deng sang le'u bzhi bcu zhe bdun las med pas mtshon/ de'ang phyis su 'phags pa mi bzhugs stabs so skye'i dge 'dun rnams kyi blo la mi bzhugs/ dpe med pa dang rgyun chad pa yin/ phyis su'ang 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ chen po bzhi/ rmad du byung ba'i slob dpon gnyis nas mkhas pa sgo drug sogs kyi bar rgyal bstan gsal bar mdzad pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ji snyed cig byon/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ni 'bras bu'i dus tsam ches snga ba nas nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul du byon te slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje sogs 'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po'i sku brnyes pa rnams kyis a ti yo ga'i bstan pa spel/ in+d+ra bhū ti dang mtsho skyes zhabs sogs grub pa sde bdun gyi gzhung mdzad pa rnams kyis phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag rgya cher spel/ grub pa'i tshogs mtha' yas par byon kyang 'phags pa'i yul du sngar gtan nas ma grags/ phyis thor bu tsam byon pa rtsol med kyi theg pa'i chos so so'i skye bo'i blor mi shong bas the tshom dang log lta'i rgyur 'gro/ de'i rkyen gyis bstan pa nyams pa dang mnar med dmyal ba'i rgyu bsgrub par gzigs nas srid skyong rgyal po dang chos skyong rgyal po gnyis kyis rdo rje gdan gyi 'og sogs su gter du sbas te rgya ru sprod kyis btab pas sus kyang mthong tshor med/ rta mchog zhabs dang sa ra ha sogs lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung*/ phyag rgya chen po'i mchog grub/ o rgyan nas gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde mang du spyan drangs/

de nas rim par lū dril nag gsum nas bzung phyis grub chen tai lo pa'i bar grub pa'i dbang phyug du mar byon pa rnams kyis bde mchog dang dgyes rdor sogs rgyud sde mang du spyan drangs nas skal ldan re re tsam la spel/ 'phags yul gyi gsang sngags pa rnams gsang ba shin tu bsrung ba yin pas grub pa'i slob dpon gcig las man ngag sne gcig tsam gsan nas dka' spyad chen pos lo grangs bcu gnyis tsam du de kho na la nyin mtshan kun tu nyams len chig dril du mdzad pas sbyor lam chos mchog man chad kyi lam bgrod/ de nas lhag pa'i lhas lung bstan pa ltar grub brnyes kyi slob dpon tshol nas de'i gdams ngag la brten te spyod pa mdzad pas 'phags pa'i sa brnyes te mchog gi grub pa nyams 'og tu chud/ mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul la sogs la mnga' brnyes te cho 'phrul chen po skye bo'i mngon du bstan pa na 'di ni grub pa thob pa zhig go zhes shes pa ma gtogs sngar nas sngags la zhugs pa yin min sus kyang mi rtogs/ spyir rgyud sde bzhi las bya spyod kyi rig pa 'dzin pa 'bum phrag tsam byung bar grags shing bya spyod kyi rgyud rnams shin tu dar/ de nas rnal 'byor rgyud la dngos grub brnyes pa dang slob dpon mkhas pa mang du byon nas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud shin tu dar/ phyis bla med grub pa'i slob dpon rnams byon te bla med rgyud sde dar ba nas bzung snga ma rnams rim par nyams/ bod yul du chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i skabs thu mi sam+bho ṭas 'phags yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta las saṃskṛ ta'i skad dang yi ge legs par bslabs/ de la dper mdzad nas bod kyi yi ge'i gzugs dang brda dag gi lam srol thog mar btod/ dam chos 'ga' zhig kyang rgya skad las bod skad du bsgyur ba'i srol btsugs/ bod byol song dang 'dra ba rnams la lugs gnyis kyi brda 'phrod pa'i smra ba'i sgo thog mar phyes pa yin pas 'di dang 'dra ba'i shes rab can gyi mkhas pa dang bka' drin che ba ni su yang ma byung bar snang*/

chos rgyal khri srong gis rgyal bstan thog mar spel ba'i skabs sgrub dus kyang phyed tsam yol bas 'phags yul du yongs su grags pa'i paṇa grub rnams ni mi bzhugs/ rnal 'byor pa dang paṇ+ḍi ta dkyus 'gre tsam bzhugs pa'i skabs yin 'dug kyang thugs bskyed dang sngon smon dbang gis 'chi med rig 'dzin pad+ma saṃ bha ba dang mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho spyan drangs/ mkhan pos rab byung gi sde btsugs/ rgya gar paṇa chen mang po dang bod kyi lo tsā ba rnams kyis 'phags yul du gang bzhugs kyi dam chos rnams bsgyur/ rgyal bstan nyi ma shar ba lta bur mdzad/ 'bras dus yol stabs mdo 'dul gyis 'bras bu thob pa ni su yang ma byung*/ gu ru rin po ches rdo rje theg pa'i zab lam skal ldan rnams la lkog chos su bstsal bas bka' babs mi dgu sogs grub pa thob pa bgrang las 'das par byung*/ rgyal rabs gnyis tsam nas glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs/ 'dul bstan nyams pa'i skabs su'ang sngags 'chang grub thob rgyun ma chad par byung yang phyis nas lta spyod rim par dman pas sngags bstan 'chol bar spyod pa'i skabs lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po sogs 'phags yul du byon nas phyis byon gyi rgyud sde rnams bod du bsgyur/ stod 'dul smad 'dul gnyis las 'dul ba'i bstan pa'ang dar bar byung*/ mar 'gos 'brog gsum sogs 'phags yul la byon dus mkhas pa sgo drug bzhugs pa'i skabs yin kyang nā ro pa ni mar pa lo tsā tsam las gzhan gyis bsten rgyu ma byung ba dang*/ 'phags yul gyi slob dpon shing rta pa thams cad kyi rjes ma a bha yā ka ra byon tshun chad nas ba ri lo tsā ba sogs lo tsā ba phyi ma thams cad de'i rjes 'brang 'ba' zhig tu song stabs bla med rgyud sde rnams la rdor phreng gis rgyas bkab kho na 'dug snga 'gyur gyi lo tsā ba bai ro tsa na sogs ma gtogs 'phags yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta la 'gran nus pa'i shes rab can gyi mkhas pa ni bod yul du su'ang ma byung yang*/

gangs can nyid du yongs su grags pa'i mkhas pa klong chen rab 'byams bzang po/ sa skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rong ston shes bya kun rig rje rin po che blo bzang grags pa sogs rang rkang tshugs nges pa'i mkhas pa byon 'dug lo tsā dang mkhas par grags pa phyis byon rnams ni snga ma'i lad mo zlo ba tsam las ma byung*/ mi 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang rgya che ba'i shes rab dang*/ zab pa'i shes rab dang*/ rno ba'i shes rab dang*/ 'dzin pa'i shes rab dang*/ spobs pa mtho zhing myur ba sogs dang mi ldan pas gsung rab mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa mi rtogs pa gzhir bcas/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi gzhung lugs re zung tsam la phyogs tsam go ba'i nga rgyal gyis bstan bcos re brtsams na'ang rang lugs ma yin pa thams cad thub bstan gyi phyogs su mi gtogs pa lta bu'i ngan smra dang phyogs lhung kho nar gyur pa mthong ba ni shes rab 'chal ba zhes bya ba de yin la/ bstan pa phyi dar skabs su rje btsun mi la ras pa dang*/ khyung po rnal 'byor gnyis 'phags yul gyi grub chen rnams dang mnyam pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ de dag gi brgyud 'dzin bka' brgyud che bzhi chung brgyad/ shangs pa bka' brgyud/ rin chen rnam lnga/ phyis su de'i brgyud 'dzin thang stong rgyal po sogs grub pa'i mngon rtogs brnyes pa yin 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa nus pa thob pa ni shin tu mang bar byon yang grub pa thob pa ni ma byung*/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa la 'phags pa dang*/ nus pa cung zad thob pa la grub thob tu btags pa ni rgyu mtshan mi shes pa'i bod rnams kyi spyi lugs yin par 'dug des na lung gi bstan pa'ang gzhug la thug cing snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i skabs 'dir tshul ldan ga la 'byung yang*/ bstan pa dar ba'i skabs kyi 'phags pa rnams dang*/ deng sang dge slong sdom gtsang re ngo mnyam pa dang*/

sngon gyi grub chen dang deng sang sngags kyi lam nas bde stong gi ting 'dzin phyogs tsam skyes pa yon tan mnyam par gsungs pa la dgongs pas/ rje 'di nyid sku na phra mo'i dus na zab rgyas kyi shes rab dang*/ spobs pa mtho zhing myur bas mdo rgyud kyi gting dpog pa'i mkhas pa dang*/ chos nyid kyi bden pa gzigs pa'i rtags mngon shes thogs pa med pa sogs grub pa thob pa'i rtags mngon 'gyur du mnga' yang gdul bya rnams yang dag pa'i lam la bkri ba'i slad du sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen phyogs ris med pa nyis brgya lhag tsam bsten par mdzad/ rang gi yon tan ni shin tu sbed cing rgyus med rnams kyis phyogs tsam yang mi mthong*/ gzhan gyi yon tan phra mo tsam la'ang thugs shin tu dwangs pa'i tshul gyis bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor zhing dge legs kyi dbyangs snyan 'khrol bar mdzad/ go sa mtho zhing stobs 'byor sogs gzi brjid che ba dang*/ snyan grags ldan pa rnams la'ang cal sgrog gi rjes su 'brangs nas ma brtags par zab chos gsan pa dang*/ dbang 'brel chos 'brel gsan pa sogs gtan nas mi mdzad/ bka' chos gsan pa na'ang rang nyid rigs rus mtho ba'i nga rgyal dang yon tan che ba'i khengs pa gtan nas mi mnga' bar dman pas mchog la btud pa ltar gus 'dud dang*/ bka' drin che chung dang bstun pa'i dngos 'bul gya nom pa phyag khar gang bzhugs ser sna med par mchod pa'i sprin tu spro bar mdzad cing*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis mtshon rags rim tsam 'og tu 'byung ngo*// bzhi pa thos pa phyogs med btsal bas khyad par 'phags pa ni/ thog mar yab drung chen pa las sbyor klog phyag bris yig rigs/ brda dag rnams gsan/ drung 'tsho mkhas dbang tshe dbang dpal 'byor las rgyud bzhi'i bshad pa/ lag len/ 'tsho byed tshe dbang las dngul chu btso bkru dang rin chen ril bu'i phyag len/

de gnyis dang gzhan mang po las gso rigs kyi gzhung che chung dang phyag len zhib par gsan nas lo shas phyag len du'ang btab/ bzo rigs ched du ma bslabs kyang sku gsung thugs rten gyi cha tshad/ dkyil 'khor thig rtsa sogs kyang zhar byung gzigs pas shin tu mkhas pa mkhyen/ zhe chen paṇ+ḍi ta 'gyur med bstan 'dzin 'phel rgyas las sgra ka tsān dbyangs gsum gzhung*/ sdeb sbyor/ snyan ngag me long rnams gsan nas brda' sprod la byang chub cing gsung brtsams khyad 'phags rang babs lta bur song*/ bkras lhun ka chen sogs las tshad ma rnam 'grel gtsos pa'i gzhung lugs dang rig pa'i 'gro phyogs gsan/ rtog ge'i rtsod grwa la ma zhugs kyang mkhas 'dod nga rgyal can thams cad kyi spobs pa bcom/ smin gling mkhan po 'gyur med kun ldan las so thar gyi sdom pa gsan nas dge slong gi kun spyod gtsang seng nge bar mdzad/ na len+d+ra'i khri 'dzin byams pa bstan 'dzin snyan grags las mngon rtogs rgyan/ li thang dge bshes byams pa phun tshogs las dbu ma 'jug pa/ mngon pa mdzod rnams kyi bshad pa dang*/ gzhan yang dge bshes 'ga' zhig las deng sang rgyun gang bzhugs kyi rgya gzhung rnams kyi bshad pa gsan nas shin tu mkhas par mdzad/ 'jam mgon rdo rje rin chen sku mched/ ngor thar rtse mkhan chen byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang*/ rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po/ 'bum ram mkhan po dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ yar klung pa/ gzim 'og sprul sku/ ngor pa dpon slob ngag dbang legs grub sogs yongs 'dzin du ma las dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i smin byed rnams dang*/ lam 'bras tshogs bshad/ slob bshad rnams kyis thog drangs pa'i sa ngor tshar gsum la gang bzhugs kyi rgyud sde rnams kyi dbang*/ de dag gi rdzogs rim gyi khrid/ yig cha rnams dang sa skya'i gong ma rnam lnga/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dang dkon mchog lhun grub/ go rams pa bsod nams seng ge/

sa ngor phyis byon rnams kyi bka' 'bum lung rgyun gang bzhugs gsan/ snga 'gyur rnying ma'i phyogs la kaḥthog pa rmog ston chos dbyings rdo rje/ byang chub chos kyi nyi ma/ smin gling khri chen 'gyur med sangs rgyas kun dga'/ rje btsun ma phrin las chos sgron/ rta nag pa 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ khams phyogs rdzogs chen pa 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu/ dge mang mchog sprul gzhan phan mtha' yas/ dpal yul rgya sprul karma kun bzang bstan 'dzin/ dzaḥka mchog sprul kun bzang rnam rgyal/ kho bos kyang rnying skor bka' gter gang thos phul ba sogs rnying phyogs kyi yongs 'dzin mang po las a ti yo ga sems klong man ngag gi sde/ a nu yo ga 'dus pa mdo/ ma hā yo ga sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dbang*/ rgyud rgyal gsang ba snying po'i gzhung bshad/ bka' ma'i rgyud sde'i dbang rgyun gang bzhugs rnams dang*/ mchog gi sprul sku rnam gsum/ gling chen bcu gnyis/ dri med rnams gsum nas bzung phyis kyi nus ldan nyer gcig gi bar du byon pa'i gnyer chos rtsod bral thams cad kyi dbang*/ gzhung pod kyi lung*/ bka' dgongs phur gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i phyag len khyad par can thams cad gsan/ rgyal dbang karma pa theg pa mchog gi rdo rje/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang po/ mkhan chen karma nges don bstan pa rab rgyas/ 'bri gung slob dpon tshe bdag pa/ stag lung ngag dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma/ kho bos kyang bka' brgyud skor phal mo che phul ba sogs dwags po bka' brgyud rtsa ba dang*/ karma kaṃ tshang*/ phag gru/ tshal pa ste bka' brgyud che bzhi dang*/ khro gling*/ 'bri stag smar g.yel/ g.yam shug bcas bka' brgyud chung brgyad de de dag gi smin grol gdams ngag deng sangs rgyun gang bzhugs thams cad gsan/ zhwa lu mchog sprul blo gsal bstan skyong*/ gangs dkar rdo rje gdan pa zung las dpal rtse dbyings gsum gyi dbang bka' so so'i lugs srol/

khyad par zhwa lu pa las bu ston bka' 'bum rgyun gang bzhugs rnams kyi dbang lung gsan/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gi khrid brgya smin khrid du gsan/ lcags zam brgyad pa sogs yongs 'dzin rnam pa gsum las dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi smin grol gdams ngag mtha' dag gsan/ ri bo dge ldan pa'i dge bshes chen po lha btsun ye shes don grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ brag sgam zhabs drung dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas gtsos dge bshes 'ga' zhig las jo bo rje'i skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim/ lam rim gyi khrid snga phyi lugs srol mang tsam/ 'brom ston/ pu to ba/ spyan snga/ phu chung ba/ de dag rnams kyi slob brgyud las byon pa'i bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che/ gzhung*/ gdams ngag man ngag rjes 'brang dang bcas pa bka' gdams rnying ma deng sang dpe rgyun lung rgyun gang bzhugs/ rje rin po che blo bzang grags pa'i gsung 'bum kha shas sogs bka' gdams gsar ma gnad che rigs rnams gsan/ nyams len dang ldan pa'i rtogs ldan 'ga' zhig las/ pha dam pa'i zhi byed/ ma gcig lab sgron gyi gcod yul lugs srol drug tsam gyi smin grol gsan/ kho bo las kun mkhyen dol po sangs rgyas kyi bka' 'bum/ rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i rgyud sde sngar yod dang gsar 'gyur bcas rnam grangs shin tu mang po'i dbang khrid lung rgyun rnams tshang bar phul/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che/ rnying ma rgyud 'bum/ bstan 'gyur las lung rgyun bzhugs pa'i pod sum cu tsam/ gsar rnying bla ma gong ma tshad ldan phal mo che'i bka' 'bum/ gtam tshogs phra mo yan la'ang khyad gsod mi mdzad par lung rgyun gsan/ rdo rje phreng ba/ mi tra brgya rtsa/ ba ri lo tsā'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang rgya mtsho/ smin gling 'dod 'jo bum bzang*/ snar thang brgya rtsa/ jo nang rin 'byung sogs dbang dang rjes gnang gi rigs rgyun gang bzhugs rnams gsan te thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' bdag chen por gyur pa'o// lnga pa bsam pas rnam par nges pas khyad par 'phags pa ni/

gang gsan pa'i chos bka' de dag dbus gtsang khams gsum du spar rgyun gang bzhugs thams cad de 'phral spar du 'debs pa gnang*/ 'bri dgos pa thams cad glegs bam 'phral du bzhengs nas sku gzhon pa'i skabs nyin mtshan sbrel mar glegs bam rnams la gzigs nas so so'i tshig don thams cad phan tshun ma 'dres par thugs la shin tu nges pa mdzad/ bye mdo dbu sems te grub mtha' chen po bzhi dang*/ gsar rnying rgyud sde rnams la mtha' drug tshul bzhis gtan la phab pa'i tshul rnams dpyis phyin par mkhyen pas/ so so'i ring lugs smra ba'i mkhas pa mchog dman su zhig gi spyan sngar phyin kyang so so'i lugs srol de'i dang po byung khungs/ smin grol rnams kyi rgyun/ so so'i lag len gyi lugs srol sogs pha rol po des phyogs su'ang mi phyin pa'i legs bshad yar ngo'i zla ba'i lang tsho ngom pas skal ldan kun+da'i blo gros kyi 'dab ma lhag par bzhad cing*/ skal dman spobs pa'i chu skyes shin tu zum par gyur pa nyid do// drug pa sgom pa nyams len phyogs med du mdzad pas khyad par 'phags pa ni/ gsar rnying rgyud sde gsan tshad rnams kyi bsnyen pa/ nye bsnyen/ sgrub pa/ sgrub chen rnams mthar phyin pa dang*/ snying thig ya bzhi/ lam 'bras rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ bka' gdams lam rim dang blo sbyong rgyas bsdus/ phyag chen lugs srol gsum dang*/ nā ro dang ni gu'i chos drug zhi byed lam lnga/ gcod yul lam khyer/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa/ o rgyan pa'i bsnyen sgrub rnams kyi nyams bzhes so sor rtags thon pa re mdzad/ rdzong sar bzhugs gnas su lo gsum bcad rgya'i khongs su rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gi khrid brgya thog ma'i zhen pa bzhi bral nas bzung gsham gyi nor bu mthong grol gyi bar thams cad nyams bzhes mdzad pas nyams rtogs yon tan yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel/ sku tshe'i mjug nas rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid dang mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po zung du 'jug pa mthar thug pa'i rtogs pa mngon tu gyur te nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor par zhal gyis bzhes pa nyid tshu rol mthong ba rnams kyis kyang mngon tu gyur pa nyid do// bdun pa bstan pa phyogs med du skyong bas khyad par 'phags pa ni/

ston pa shākya'i dbang po rjes 'brang bshad brgyud 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang*/ sgrub brgyud shing rta brgyad kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa rnams su ma zad/ g.yung drung bon gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa yan chad la mchog dman dang nye ring phyogs lhung gtan nas mi mnga' bar so so'i gang la gang 'dod par dbang bskur lung khrid rnams sku na gzhon dus nas zhi bar gshegs kyi bar nyin mtshan sbrel mar chu bo'i rgyun ltar chad par med par stsol ba dang*/ so so'i yid la 'thad pa'i spro bskyed gzengs bstod bsngags pa brjod pas kyang dga' ba bskyed pa dang*/ ris su ma chad pa'i bstan 'dzin rnams la bsnyen bkur rgya che bas dgyes pa bskyed cing*/ gsar ma'i dgon gnas rnams su so so'i rang lugs kyi rgyud sde rnams kyi sgrub mchod gsar 'dzugs thebs su phyag rdzas gang yod kyi yon sbyor dang*/ dgon dpon chos rje rnams la'ang skul ma mdzad/ rnying ma'i dgon gnas rnams su'ang snga 'gyur bka' gter mang po'i sgrub rgyun de mtshungs/ mdo 'dul chos spyod kyi phyag len rnams kyang de bzhin mdzad pas/ sa ngor/ rnying ma/ bka' brgyud/ bka' gdams/ zhi gcod/ jo zhal sogs kyi brgyud 'dzin dgon gnas thams cad la rje 'di nyid kyi bka' drin dpag bsam ljon shing gi grib bsil du ngal 'tsho ma bsten pa gcig kyang mi srid pa lta bur snang ba ni/ ji skad du/ dang por zang zing sbyin pas bsdus// bar du snyan pa'i gtam gyis brid// tha mar don mthun chos kyis skyong*// rang nyid chos bzhin spyod pa'o// zhes byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa khyad par du 'phags pa bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi phyag len tu bstar ba 'di lta bu ni shin tu dkon par 'dug go /brgyad pa phrin las phyogs med du skyong bas khyad par 'phags pa ni/ gso rig phyag len gnang ba'i skabs sman dpyad kyis phan thogs shin tu che bas skye rgu mang po la mi 'jigs srog gi sbyin pa bstsal zhing gso rig la mkhas pa'i slob rgyun kyang mang du byung*/

thar rtse mkhan chen kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang dpon slob ngag dbang legs grub sogs la brda sprod snyan ngag gi sbyor ba bslabs pas shin tu mkhas par thugs su chub nas phyag rjes ngo mtshar ba byung song*/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zhal ngo*/ ngor gyi mkhan po dang slob dpon/ tshar lugs kyi brgyud 'dzin phyogs su byon pa'i chos rje rnams la rang lugs kyi chos sbyin ji ltar 'dod pa dang*/ rnying ma rdor smin/ kaḥdapal/ zhe rdzogs kyis gtsos dgon chen rnams kyi khri 'dzin dang*/ dgon chung mang po'i bla ma grwa rigs rnams la'ang rnying ma bka' gter gyi smin grol rnams kyis rjes su bzung*/ rgyal dbang karma pa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa dang bco lnga pa/ si tu sku phreng gong 'og zur mang dgon khag gtso bor gyur pa'i kaṃ tshang bka' brgyud dang*/ mdo khams pa sogs 'brug lugs pa rnams dang*/ ri bo che'i rje drung sogs stag lung pa rnams dang*/ bla ma lho pa sogs 'bri gung pa ste dwags po bka' brgyud pa rnams kyi bla sprul grwa rigs thams cad la'ang smin grol gdams pa sogs kyis rjes 'dzin mdzad/ brag g.yab no mi han dang gdong kaṃ sprul sku/ li thang phyogs kyi dge bshes che phra sogs dge lugs pa du ma la'ang bka' chos gang 'dod pa stsal/ gong smos so sor chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas tshim par mdzad cing*/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang*/ de dag la mchod pa'i yo byad rgya cher bzhugs gnas kyi dgon par bzhengs bkod dang*/ dgon gnas gzhan du'ang 'dod mos dang mthun par mchod pa'i rten du stsal zhing*/ bzhengs mkhan lha bzo/ bris rkos/ shing mkhan/ mgar ba sogs la'ang gsol chas yon sbyin legs so'i dga' ston bcas rgya che spom mtho bas thams cad kyi yid mgu bar bskyed cing*/ zang zing gi dngos po la rlom sems dang ser sna mi mnga' bar gtong ba'i mdzad pa rdzogs ldan gyi sprin gyi bla bre las 'dod rgu nor bu'i char rgyun 'bad med lhug par 'bebs par mdzad pa nyid do// des mdzad pa po'i che ba'i yon tan phyogs tsam brjod pa grub/

gnyis pa lung gang las btus na/ 'phags yul du thub bstan 'bras bu'i dus yol nas sgrub pa'i bstan pa la babs pa'i skabs tsam rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud dang grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams rim par byon par snang zhing*/ de'ang bstan pa snga dar rim pa gnyis/ bar dar rim pa gnyis/ phyi dar rim pa gnyis te drug tsam gsungs/ grub thob rnams kyi gsung dang sngags kyi phyag len la'ang so so'i skabs dang mthun pa'i khyad par che ba re re yod/ phyi dar gyi lo tsā ba rga lo sogs byon pa'i skabs ni phyi dar gyi rim pa gnyis pa la bab/ a bha yā ka ra'ang sku gshegs nas rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po tsā mi sangs rgyas grags kyis mdzad cing bstan pa skyong ba'i skabs yin par 'dug ba ri lo tsā sogs byon pa'i skabs a bha ya'i slob ma ma han+ta nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams bzhugs skabs yin pas phyag len thams cad phreng ba skor gsum gyi rjes 'brang kho nar song*/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang rgya mtsho rnams 'di skabs zhus nas bod du byung*/ rdo rje phreng ba dang*/ bla med kyi sngags rgyud mang po'ang mal lo tsā dang*/ yar klung lo tsā ba sogs mang pos bod du bsgyur nas smin grol gdams pa spel ba las gtso bor rje btsun sa skya pa khu dbon la bka' babs te rgyud sde chen po rnams kyi dbang dang bshad bka' sgrub thabs rnams kyi rjes gnang dang rgya gzhung gi lung sogs kyi rgyun srol zla med par btsugs/ rje btsun grags pas rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis tsam thugs su chub cing 'phags yul nas byon pa'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa du ma gsan cing snyan brgyud du gnang bar mdzad/ de dag gi rgyud rnams rtsa ba dang*/ khungs dang 'brel nges pa'i rjes gnang dang*/ gdams ngag gi rig thams cad phyogs su bsdus pas lha'i ngo bo ni gtso bor bya rgyud dang*/ rgyud sde gzhan bzhi po'ang ci rigs par bzhugs pas rgyud sde rnam bzhi rin chen 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las zab cing nye bar mkho ba'i 'dod 'byung nor bu dbang gi rgyal po khyad par can rnams phyung te gram bur brdal bas skal ldan kun gyi dbul ba gcig char du sel bar mdzad pa'o// gsum pa phyogs gang du gtogs na/

rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa thugs rje can thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos thams cad bsdu na sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ theg pa che chung gnyis su 'du ba las 'di nyid mngon pa'i phyogs dang*/ de la'ang rgya che ba phyi'i mngon pa dang zab mo nang gi mngon pa gnyis su yod cing*/ gsang mchog rdo rje theg pa ni phyi ma nyid yin pas gzhung 'di dag de'i khongs su gtogs/ theg pa la che chung gnyis su dbye ba las theg dman nyan rang las khyad par du 'phags pa theg pa chen po/ theg chen nyid la'ang phal pa dang mchog gnyis su dbye ba'i phyi ma theg mchog bla na med pa gsang sngags kyi theg pa'i khongs su gtogs pa yin/ sngags kyi rgyud sde la mdo sde rtogs pa'i rgyud dang*/ phyi'i bya ba gtso bor ston pa bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ phyi'i spyod pa dang nang gi lta ba cha mnyam du byed pa spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ nang gi rnal 'byor rtsal du ston pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor lam du byed pa bla med kyi rgyud de/ de la'ang nang gses su thabs gtso bor gyur pa pha rgyud dang*/ shes rab gtso bor gyur pa ma rgyud gnyis bcas thams cad bsdoms pas rnam grangs drug tu bzhugs pa las/ 'dir bsgrub bya lha'i ngo bo dang*/ sgrub byed sngags kyi rnam grangs rnams ni bya spyod kyi rgyud las 'byung ba mang zhing*/ phyi ma gnyis kyang ci rigs par mchis pas rgyud sde rnams kyi phyogs su gtogs pa yin no// bzhi pa gzhung gi tshad ji tsam zhe na/ glegs bam 'di rnams su sh+lo ka dang bam po'i tshad kyis bcad du med kyang*/ chos tshan so so'i bzhugs tshul 'og gi dkar chag las 'byung bas 'dir smos ma dgos so// lnga pa gzhung 'di sdud pa'i dgos pa gang zhig yin na/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i skabs su dam pa'i chos mtha' dag 'dzin pa las kyang snyigs ma'i dus mthar bstan pa nub la nye ba'i skabs 'dir dam pa'i chos sh+lo ka re re tsam 'dzin skyong spel ba phan yon che bar gsungs pa dang*/

7 dge lugs dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam gzhag sbyin sreg bcas/ 12 'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo'i sgrub thabs gtor chog 19 srog bdag dmar po'i drag sngags shan pa sgrol byed kyi rgyud dang bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi man ngag bcas/ 10 nor lha'i rjes 'brel jo lugs dzam dkar lha lnga'i phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i cho ga 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs/ 17 mgon po dzam+bha la dmar po'i phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i cho ga pad+ma rā ga'i lcags kyu/ 9 bsngo smon bkra shis/ 6 bcas bsdoms (327)bzhugs/ de ltar dkar chag rtsa ba dang yan lag gis zin pa'i rigs gong du song ba rnams las kun rig rab gnas dang*/ grong khyer sgrol 'khor gnyis kyi lung lag len btsal dgos yod cing*/ skabs 'dir 'khod ma thub pa chos sde 'dir bzhugs su 'os pa gzhan/ tshe ring mched lnga'i g.yang skyabs la dgos pa'i las byang*/ bde mchog dkar po'i khrid yig dpyal a mo gha'i yig cha/ kar lugs sgrol dkar 'od zer drug sbrags sgrub thabs rgyun khyer bstod pa bcas/ jo lugs 'jigs byed drug cu pa'i cho ga bsdus pa/ dge lugs bde smon zhing mchog sgo 'byed la brten pa'i 'od chog rnying lugs rdo rje sder mo'i sgrub thabs sogs dang*/ rje bla mas gsar spel 'phags pa nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang gzungs kyi man ngag de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa la brten pa'i sdig sbyong*/ gsar du bsgrigs bzhed mngon dga'i zhing sgrub smon lam bcas/ 'pho ba'i gdams skor rnams dang*/ bka' rgya ma'i skor/ tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma'i man ngag thun min/ bo dong lugs kyi seng gdong ma bka' bcu'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang*/ tshogs bdag sprel gdong*/ gnod sbyin a pa rā dzi ta/ seng gdong ma'i las tshogs nyer bzhi pa/ rlung 'khor yang zlog sogs dang*/ rnam sras rta bdag brgyad kyi g.yang chog sogs snang yang re zhig yul dus gang zag gi bab las smon pa'i yul du gyur pa 'di dag dang*/

gong so sor mchan gyis gsal ba rnams bcas bstan pa yal bar mi 'dor zhing zab chos rin po che dkon la rin thang che bar mkhyen pa rnams kyis chog shes mi bya bar 'bad pas btsal bar gsol ba gdab rgyu dang*/ sgrub thabs 'di dang 'brel ba'i khrid chung skor thugs chen dmar khrid gong du bkod ltar gyi gras bde gsang gshed skor gyi dmar khrid sogs rgyud sgrub thabs kyi rnam dbye phyed pas 'os shing 'thad la rgyun ma nyams pa rnams stabs su 'chad nyan mdzad pa byung na bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs bzhed du gnas tshul bden pa'i gsung las mthong bas na 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i bla slob rnams kyi mkhyen dbyings su 'jug pa cis kyang zhu/ de lta bu'i lhag pa'i lha mchog mang po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa dgos 'byung nor bu'i gter gyis gtams pa'i chu gter chen po'i 'jings las 'ongs pa'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i klung rgyun dngos grub kyi rlabs phreng chil chil g.yo ba'i bzhugs byang gi yi ge ris gsal bar bkod grub bo// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhir+bha ban+tu/ gang zhig snga na med pa'i rmad cig ston zla gsar pa'i lang tsho ngom bzhin tu// snyigs dus smag rum shin tu stug por thugs bskyed shing rtas drangs te sprin mthong bdud rtsi'i zer// skal dman 'gro ba'i chu skyes bzhin ras zum yang blo ldan kun+da'i 'dab bkrol ba// nam mkha'i nor bu des kyang phyogs tsam mi mtshon grub gnyis zil mngar 'jo ba'i dpyid// snyigs dus bstan 'dzin chen por grags rnams zang zing nyid la skyabs su bcol// dpyod ldan mkhas pa phyogs rnams yid kyi zur la ma shar ba// u dum+bā ra'i spun zlar song ba'i chos gter mchog 'dis ni// ring lugs nyams pa gsos shing smin grol chu srol 'grib bral byas// sgrub thabs lan tshwa kun la zim yang don gnad ro nus bral// nyung ngu rnam gsal yang dag rdzogs 'dis sgrub la dngos grub 'jo// li shi'i dri bsung kha nas 'thul ba'i zla bzhin 'dzum rlabs kyis// gzhon nu'i snying gi dpyid thig 'byed la stabs su lhag pa bzhin// rgyal ba'i mdzad pa dang mtshungs 'gro mang rnams// rgyal sar 'god byed byang chub spyod pa'i shes// 'dis kyang snying po'i bstan la ri mo ni// shing rta 'dren byed rnams kyi zla bor mdzad// dang ba chen pos don du gnyer ba dang*// brtson 'grus chen pos nyams su len brtson na// ring por mi thogs don gnyis lhun grub kyi// rgyal srid chen po bdag gir byed par nges// rnam dkar bla na med pa 'di yi mthus// ris su ma chad rgyal bstan kun nas rgyas// bstan pa skyong rnams zhabs brtan mdzad phrin 'phel// yun tu mi nyams bshad sgrub 'phel gyur cig

/gong ma spyi dang khyad par kun mkhyen rje'i// zag med thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs// bdag cag rnams kyang mtho ris yon tan chos// bdun ldan dpal gyis rtag tu 'khyud gyur cig /zab gsang rgyun bzang dgun gyi chu bran ltar// chad dang phra dang nyams par gyur pa kun// gzhung mchog 'di mthus dbyar gyi chu gter ltar// gong nas gong 'phel rgyun mi chad par shog /rgyu mtshan shes nas dad pa'i mig bye ste// smin grol rgyun bzang skom pa chu bsil ltar// don tu gnyer la shin tu rings pa dang*// nyams blangs thar pa'i srog rtsa rab brtan shog /'di nyid yi ge'i phyi mor skrun byed pa'i// 'bri rkos dag sdeb yon sbyor mkhan rnams kyang*// tshe 'dir bdud bgegs g.yul las rnam par rgyal// byang chub lam las phyir mi ldog gyur cig /skye kun khyab bdag bla mas rjes su bzung*// mnyes pa gsum gyis thugs yid gcig tu 'dres// gang gi gsang gsum yon tan phrin las dang*// mnyam pa nyid du chos kyi rgyal por shog /'di nyid gang du bzhugs pa'i yul khams su// snyigs ma'i rnam 'gyur lha min bdud dpung gi// gzi byin nag phyogs zla dang lhan cig nyams// dge legs rdzogs ldan sprin chen 'khrigs par shog /dkon mchog rtsa gsum bden stobs nam yang bslu ba med pa dang*// skyabs kun 'dus zhal 'khor lo'i mgon po'i thugs bskyed smon lam mthus// lhag bsam dag pa'i smon tshig dpag bsam ljon pa'i sdong po la// re 'bras khur gyis lci bas bsam don yongs grub bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di ni gtsug lag zung gi mkhyen dpyod phun sum tshogs pa rje dpon skal bzang rdo rje dang rje bla ma nyid kyi thugs rje bka' drin gyi skyabs 'og tu chud pa las mnyes pa gsum gyi zhabs tog phul du phyin par grub pas thugs zin gyi sras slob mchog tu gyur pa tshe ring bkra shis zung nas gzhung dngos la zhal skong dang spar gyi 'phros rnams gsar du bskrun pa'i brtson pa dang gtong sgo rgya cher spel ba'i skabs rin chen dang po'i gnang skyes bcas gsung skul mdzad pa don yod par bya ba'i phyir kun mkhyen bla ma rin po che'i bka' slob tha shal ba'i gras su gtogs pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'am rgyal sras blo gros mtha' yas su 'bod pas rang lo gya bdun par dbang po dang blo gros mi gsal ba'i ngang yid la gang dran spel bar bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni nye bar gnas pa'i blo gsal gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel//

༈ /gong du ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas rim par brgyud pa'i zab chos sgrub thabs kun btus kyi dbang lung man ngag dang bcas pa'i chos sde 'di ni/ bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta chen po gzhon nu'i dus nas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang bshes gnyen gyi gzugs sku bzhengs pa sa gsum gyi mgon po rje bla ma 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po zhes snyan pa'i ba dan srid rtser gzhal ba/ 'dzam gling mkhas grub yongs kyi dbus na rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mngon par mtho ba/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che sa gsum na gsal ba'i nyin mo'i dbang phyug dam pa/ zab rgyas rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i rdo rje slob dpon de nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ bstan pa rin po che'i nyi ma nub rir 'dzegs pa rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus 'dir/ bstan 'gror sman pa'i thugs bskyed rlabs po che'i khur bzhes nas/ skal ldan gyi bu slob grangs med pa smin grol gyi lam la bkod cing*/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rin po che ma nyams pa 'phel zhing*/ nyams pa sor chud pa'i ched/ dbus gtsang bod chen kun tu snying stobs dang brtson 'grus chen pos lus srog phangs pa med pa lto skya gos hrul gyi ngang du skyo ngal spangs te brgal nas mnyes pa gsum gyis yongs 'dzin gyi brgya lhag tsam bsten nas dam pa'i chos ma lus pa skom pas chu tshol ba ltar nyul nas bsnyen cing sgrub pa las tshogs dang bcas pa mthar phyin par mdzad/ phyi rabs kyi skal ldan gdul bya snod dang ldan pa yongs la sku mtshan dpe'i bkod pa yi dam gyi lhar bzhengs/ gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis log par rtog pa'i sgra bcom nas/ thugs kyi rtogs pa zab mo'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis yid kyi bum pa bzang po phyur bur gtams nas/

ris med kyi bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel ba la chags thogs med pa 'jigs bral gdong lnga'i khri la dbang bskur nas snyigs dus kyi rgud pa sel ba'i thugs bskyed zab mo bzhes/ zab chos nub tu 'phangs pa 'di dag gi bshad sgrub yun ring du gnas pa'i ched dge bshes bslab pa gsum ldan phan bde bzang po phrin las kyi do dam par bka' gnang nas chos sbyin gyi dbu gtsugs/ skabs su bstan dgra nyag rked pa'i 'tshe bas yun ring tsam bshol dgos pa byung yang*/ 'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo gong sa rgyal dbang mchog gi thugs bskyed las/ dpal sa'i dbang phyug phu lung pa rig 'dzin tshe dbang rdo rje dbus blon po chen po'i tshogs dpa' shing brtul phod pa rtsal dang snying stobs ldan pa rnams gtsos gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang pa chen po'i drag po mngon spyod kyi dpung lha dang mi'i tshogs sa chen po'i rdul lta bus sna drangs nas dgra bo 'khor dang bcas pa rmeng med du btang*/ bod chen po'i ljongs na gnas pa'i bla dpon spyi dang*/ bye brag sa dbang sde dge blon 'bangs bcas la skye ba nas tshe rabs kun tu bka' drin 'khor mtha' bral ba'i byams brtse'i gzigs pa tshad med pas bskyangs nas lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa slar yang 'phel ba'i skya rengs dang po shar/ mchod yon nyi zla zung 'brel zhal 'dzom nas mnyam med bu ram shing pa la 'jig rten gyi lha chen po rnams kyi gtsug nor gyis btud pa'i dus bzang po lta bu tshes nas srid pa bde la bkod pa'i bka' drin las/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che rta bdun dbang po g.yo med lhun po'i spo la 'khyud pa'i gnas dus bzang por chos sbyin gyi 'phro mthud/ chos grwa chen po dpal ldan lhun grub steng gi gnas lnga rigs par smra ba dgon dpon bla ma 'jam dbyangs yon tan nas dad brtson gtong ba dang bcas pa'i zhabs 'degs rgyun ring du bsgrubs/

'das pa'i skabs su'ang dge gzhug phyag rdzas kyi 'phros yod pa rnams lhag ma med par chos sbyin gyi cha rkyen du phul/ rje bla ma sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po de nyid zhing gzhan gyi gdul byar gzigs pa'i skabs su'ang rje nyid kyi zhabs pad bgrang bya nyi shu'i skor la mnyes pa gsum gyis bsten nas sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan bum pa gang byo la bzhes pa nang thugs kyi sras mchog mdo sngags bstan pa'i shing rta chen po 'jam dbyangs blo gter dbang po la mthar phyin pa'i bka'i bsdu ba po'i dag dgongs pa ched du gtad nas zhal chems kyi tshul du mdzad/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i glegs bam gcig pu brag yab gdong kong khri rin po che ngag dbang dam chos rgyal mtshan la dkar chag 'bri dgos pa'i bka' mchid stsal/ me bya lor 'phros dang kha skong rigs dbu 'dzugs rgyu'i bag chags la gnas kyang*/ rgyal khab la sku rkyen lta bus blo gter zhabs gzhan du bzhud pas bshol/ sa phag lor mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas zhabs dang*/ blo gter zhabs rnam pa gnyis bka' bgros te kha skong dgos rigs mtha' dag zin thor mdzad nas blo gter zhabs kyis chog sgrig gi dbu brtsams/ lcags bya lo nas bzung blo gter zhabs kyis kha skong chog sgrig grub rim bzhin rje nyid kyi sku'i snag dbon lugs zung mkhyen pa gsal zhing gtong phod can skal bzang rdo rjes yo byad kyi cha rkyen bsgrubs nas/ bris rkos sum cu skor tshogs te/ kho bos kyang dag zhus sogs 'gan khur lhod med bgyis pa dang*/ 'jam mgon blo gros zhabs kyis kha skong chog khrigs dpe tshan bco lnga tsam byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar bar mdzad cing*/ de 'phros blo gter zhabs kyis dpe tshan drug cu'i skor rkang bsgrigs dang*/ gzhan rje bla ma'i mdzad 'phro zhal bsabs pa bcas bsdams pusti lnga rdzogs par bka' drin bskyangs pa dang*/
